traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Universal status indicator used across transaction lists, vouchers, dashboards, and notifications. 7 semantic states and 3 emphasis levels cover all common badge use cases.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Pure display component. Carries its own background, label color, padding, and border-radius per variant. No external dependencies or slots.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Token naming follows DS convention (main/badge/{semantic}/{level}/), and the State values match the token names (Information, Positive, Notice, Negative, Muted). One issue: the Negative/Heavy and Muted/Heavy Dashboard containers have a hardcoded opacity: 0.9.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Simple leaf component. Nests cleanly in list rows, card headers, table cells, and notification banners. No child slots or complex nesting.

behavior.notes: Display-only. All 7 states x 3 levels fully defined per type.

resolved.body: Hardcoded opacity: 0.90 removed from Danger/Heavy Transaction (21:111576) and Disabled/Heavy Transaction (3714:3863) inner containers. Both now at opacity 1, consistent with the other 66 variants. C3 Fixed

State property values renamed to match token semantic names across all 60 affected variants: Info → Information, Success → Positive, Warning → Notice, Danger → Negative, Disabled → Muted. Figma State values now align 1:1 with token namespace — cleaner native mapping, no translation layer needed. C2 Fixed

recommendations.headline: Add a leading icon slot.
recommendations.body: Common pattern in fintech status badges (warning triangle, check circle, info icon). Today consumers can't pair an icon with a badge without detaching.

recommendations.headline: Consider Medium / Light levels for Primary and Brand.
recommendations.body: These states only support Heavy today — if lower-emphasis variants are needed (subtle pill, ghost badge), add them now rather than waiting for a future break.

recommendations.headline: Numeric count variant.
recommendations.body: Notification badges (inbox unread count, cart count) overlap Badge's visual space but aren't formalized here. Either document that consumers use Counter instead, or add a count variant with overflow handling ("99+").

usageGuidelines.doText: Use semantic states that match the content meaning (Positive for completed, Negative for failed, Notice for pending).
usageGuidelines.dontText: Use badges for interactive elements -- badges are display-only status indicators.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Heavy level for primary status indicators and Light/Medium for secondary or supporting context.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Use multiple Heavy badges in the same row -- visual noise. Use one Heavy + rest Light/Medium.

usageGuidelines.doText: Match badge Type to context: Default for general, Voucher for promos, Transaction for history, Dashboard for summaries.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Mix badge Types within the same list or group.

scorecard.notes: Simple single-layer structure: container with text child. Semantic naming.
Clean enum properties: State, Level, Type. Minor: State names don't match token semantic names.
All colors bound to main/badge/ tokens. Note: 2 variants have hardcoded opacity: 0.90.
Maps to custom EBBadge on both platforms. Simple text + background shape.
Display-only component. No interactive states needed.
No icons or assets. Text-only component.

variants.description: 7 State values x 3 Level values x 4 Type values = 84 theoretical. Primary and Brand only support Heavy level, so actual count is (2 x 1 x 4) + (5 x 3 x 4) = 8 + 60 = 68 variants.

rows.body: Opacity normalized -- Hardcoded opacity: 0.90 removed from Danger/Heavy Transaction (21:111576) and Disabled/Heavy Transaction (3714:3863) inner containers. Both now at opacity 1, consistent with the other 66 variants. Fixed

State values renamed to match token semantics -- 60 variants renamed: Info -> Information, Success -> Positive, Warning -> Notice, Danger -> Negative, Disabled -> Muted. Figma State property now aligns 1:1 with token namespace (main/badge/{information|positive|notice|negative|muted}/{level}/). Cleaner Code Connect mapping with no translation layer. Fixed

Component assessed -- 68 variants documented across State (Primary/Brand/Info/Success/Warning/Danger/Disabled) x Level (Heavy/Medium/Light) x Type (Default/Voucher/Transaction/Dashboard). Token audit confirms all colors bound to main/badge/{semantic}/{level}/ tokens. Documented

Hardcoded opacity on 2 variants -- Danger/Heavy and Disabled/Heavy Transaction variants have opacity: 0.90 on container instead of using token-driven values. Inconsistent with other variants. Fixed in 1.1.0

State-to-token name mismatch -- Figma property names (Info, Success, Warning, Danger, Disabled) don't match token semantic names (information, positive, notice, negative, muted). Minor friction for automated Code Connect mapping. Fixed in 1.1.0
Code Connect mappings -- No CLI mappings registered yet. Property naming is clean and ready for mapping. Open
